page.overview:
Who is Clive Rosfield?

In his intro and win interactions with others, Clive is shown to be both greatly determined and earnest, in spite of his confusion at being brought to a world seperate from his own. In his home series, Clive is depicted throughout as kind-hearted, with a desire to help those in need even at the exasperation of others around him, and a tendency to shoulder the burdens of others.

Clive is a muscular young man with wild dark brown hair reaching the nape of his neck and framing the sides of his face, covering his ears. He has blue eyes, a light beard and thin moustache, and a large brand on his left cheek.

Official Website Profile (Japanese) Clive Rosfield is the first prince of the exiled country of Rosalia and a “dominant” who possesses the power of a summoned beast in his body.

Based on his beliefs, Clive has been fighting to create “a place where people can live as human beings,” but one day before the final battle, he is attacked by someone who strongly interferes with his mind and he loses consciousness.
